title: Mediterranean Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew inspired by the flavors of the Mediterranean, perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: 1. Heat the light in a large pot over medium heat.
2. Add the stew and cook, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks, until browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Stir in the Mediterranean herbs and spices blend.
4. Add the applesauce and stir to combine.
5. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
6. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
7. Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
